ZhipuAdapter — ProviderPort for Z.AI Coding (GLM series).

API endpoint: https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions Auth: Bearer token via Authorization header Model: glm-4-flash (default) or configurable

GLM quirks absorbed here:

  • Native tools declared in caps(): web_search, code_interpreter
  • Tool format differs from OpenAI: uses "type":"function" wrapper same as OAI but native tools are passed as {"type":"web_search"} etc.
  • No streaming in F1 (streaming added in F4)
